name: Laravel 12 + AI Features (pgvector)
note: Each task runs a real command. No token figures are recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost directly from the kit files. The suite is Pest and runs against SQLite in-memory (DB_CONNECTION=sqlite, DB_DATABASE=:memory: in phpunit.xml) so no PostgreSQL service is required. pgvector's <=> operator cannot execute on SQLite, so the vector query is asserted on its generated SQL and bindings, and the migration stores embedding as text on non-pgsql drivers. The AI provider is the kit's deterministic mock; no network call is made. NOT covered because the kit ships no implementation: SEC-06 rate and token budgets, SEC-07 DTO output validation, SEC-08 egress allowlist, SEC-09 canary tokens, SEC-10 streaming auth, SEC-12 queue poison handling. SEC-13 and SEC-14 are pipeline gates.

eval_tasks.title: Application installs and boots
eval_tasks.instruction: Composer dependencies must resolve and the Laravel application must bootstrap far enough to list its routes.

eval_tasks.title: Feature behaviour
eval_tasks.instruction: The kit's feature tests must pass.
assertions: structured completion returns summary and confidence

eval_tasks.title: Declared security controls hold under test
eval_tasks.instruction: Run the suite that exercises the controls named in security/checks.json. Each test is mutation-verified where the control lives in kit code: removing the control makes the test fail.
assertions: SEC-01 .env.example ships empty APP_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY
SEC-03 injection phrases (incl. extra whitespace) are blocked and user input cannot close the <user_query> delimiter
SEC-04 the pgvector query binds the vector and coerces values to floats
SEC-05 cosineSearch requires a tenant and always filters tenant_id
role and team_id are not mass-assignable

eval_tasks.title: Full suite green
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete suite must pass with no failures.
